channel.title: Recusant Crown: Milestones
channel.description: Achievements unlocked on the way to Recusant Crown: new chapters, tales, card sets and site updates.

item.title: Chapter 4: Flotsam live
item.description: A sphinx's riddle in the Unending Library, and Nikko's first day in Betwixt.

item.title: Tale: The Kingdom Without Measure live
item.description: A king, a princess with an apple, and the long argument over how long a foot is.

item.title: 36 more cards get their art, 42 get flavor text
item.description: A big art day: 36 cards traded placeholders for real illustrations, and 42 short cards picked up a line of flavor.

item.title: Essence gets its balance pass, plus nine new cards
item.description: Sixteen Essence cards retuned in text, cost and type, and nine new ones (#417 to #425) join the set.

item.title: The Light faction gets its balance pass, plus seven new cards
item.description: Light cards retuned and bloom costs raised, and seven new cards join, Honk Wrangler and Recumbent Princess among them. Every faction now has its own bloom flower too.

item.title: Link previews, a 404 page, and RSS in every footer
item.description: Shared links now show a proper preview, wrong turns land on a broken-crown 404, and every page links to X and this feed.

item.title: The Dark faction gets its first balance pass
item.description: 34 Dark cards retuned, Dive cycle included. Stickier, trickier, and a little meaner.

item.title: Every card now draws itself
item.description: The Library builds each card live from its data, so a fixed card is fixed everywhere the moment it lands.

item.title: Tale: The Rose Untouchable live
item.description: The hidden story under Sleeping Beauty and Beauty and the Beast. Bring tissues.

item.title: PreAlpha Base Set revision 1.00 uploaded
item.description: The whole first set, illustrated, in the Library and ready to print at home.

item.title: Blog post: October Progress
item.description: The most productive month in seven years, written up between factory shifts.

item.title: Chapter 3: Undertow live
item.description: A storm, a road trip, and the fall of Shin-Seibu.

item.title: The card Library opens
item.description: Browse every card, download it, or print a sheet on your kitchen printer.
